questions.question: Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. (13, 10, 39) → 13 × (13 - 10) = 13 × 3 = 39

Similarly,

(18, 13, 90) → 18 × (18 - 13) = 18 × 5 = 90

Logic: (Multiplication of digits of 1st number) + 1 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 78 - 57
